name: Maurice Utrillo

summary.text: Maurice Utrillo was a French painter of the School of Paris who specialized in cityscapes. From the Montmartre quarter of Paris, France, Utrillo is one of the few famous painters of Montmartre to have been born there.
summary.title: Maurice Utrillo
